Each day opens with a warm-up and closes with a wrap-up. A module is a briefing, a lab and a debrief; on Days 2 and 3 the afternoon is an applied clinic tied to that day's decision. The [intro slides](slides/welcome.qmd) open Day 1.

[Module 0 · {{< var modules.m00.title >}}](modules/00-prework.qmd) is optional pre-work, done on your own before Day 1.

:::
